data.name: Deeper Indoctrination
data.description: Mental conditioning has bolstered your mind against most magical control. You gain a +1 bonus on Will saving throws, except when resisting charm or compulsion effects created by lawful evil creatures, in which case you instead take a -2 penalty on Will saving throws.
